Hobbies and Confidence at Work

兴趣爱好与工作自信

OriginalFull translation

[A] A number of studies have looked at how family life can affect productivity and satisfaction in the workplace. However, there has been surprisingly little research on the influence of leisure activities. So Ciara Kelly and colleagues recruited 129 hobbyists to look at how the time spent on their hobbies shaped their work life.

[B] The researchers found that when participants spent longer than normal on their leisure activity, their belief in their ability to perform their job was strengthened. But this was only the case when they had a serious hobby that was dissimilar to their job, or when their hobby was similar to their work but they only did it casually. When their hobby was both serious and similar to their job, then spending more time on it actually decreased their work efficiency.

[C] Why might that be? To maintain a serious hobby, people need to invest significant psychological resources, say the authors—so if the activity has the same kinds of demands as their work, they may be left exhausted and unable to perform well at their job. But if their hobby is quite different from their career, it may not interfere in the same way but instead help them develop other knowledge and skills that can boost their confidence at work. “Consider a scientist who is a keen rock climber,” says Kelly. “Since climbing is so far removed from their day-to-day work activities, they can still recover from the demands of their job with plenty of resources.”

Full translation

[A] 许多研究考察了家庭生活如何影响工作场所中的生产效率和满意度。然而，关于休闲活动影响的研究却少得令人惊讶。因此，席亚拉·凯利及其同事招募了129名业余爱好者，考察他们花在兴趣爱好上的时间如何影响其工作生活。

[B] 研究人员发现，当参与者花在休闲活动上的时间比平时更长时，他们对自己胜任工作的能力更有信心。但这种情况只出现在以下两种情形：他们认真投入的爱好与工作不同；或者爱好与工作相似，但他们只是随意地参与。当他们既认真投入爱好，而爱好又与工作相似时，在爱好上花更多时间实际上会降低工作效率。

[C] 为什么会这样呢？作者指出，要维持一项认真投入的爱好，人们需要投入大量心理资源。因此，如果这项活动与工作提出的要求相同，他们就可能变得筋疲力尽，无法在工作中表现良好。但如果爱好与职业有很大不同，它可能就不会以同样的方式干扰工作，反而能帮助他们掌握其他知识和技能，从而增强工作中的自信。凯利说：“想想一位热衷攀岩的科学家。由于攀岩与他们的日常工作活动相去甚远，他们仍能从工作带来的消耗中恢复过来，并保有充足的资源。”
